CustomField.description: Experience Cloud site base path used to build push-notification deep links, e.g. /HamiltonPortal/. Must match the site this org serves the portal from — a push target without this prefix resolves to the domain root and lands on the "No Longer Supported" page.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Site path prefix with leading and trailing slashes, e.g. /HamiltonPortal/. Differs per org - verify before deploying to production.
CustomField.label: Site Base Path
